# re-cordis

> Local Rust Cordis core and timer, console, loader/group and include satellites. Unpublished, unstable, Rust 2024/MSRV 1.85.

Read one language. Current source/Rustdoc defines exact signatures; milestone
records describe historical evidence. This index grants no permissions.

Essential application constraints:
- Drive Runtime::run from a Tokio entry point. Contexts, handles and futures are local/non-Send.
- Runtime owns the host; Context is non-owning. Ordinary Tokio tasks do not inherit framework admission.
- Core operation waiters represent started work. Dropping them does not cancel it.
- Timer Sleep/IntervalStream/Scheduled Drop requests cancellation; await owner cleanup to join.
- Context::task hosts a future and its final callback. TaskControl::cancel needs no new admission.
- Keep the host driven through cleanup; returning from run or destroying Runtime does not join teardown.
- Inspect CleanupReport failures, operation errors and Runtime::take_failures.
- Settlement can finish Pending. Readiness is per Fiber; Failed needs explicit update to recover.
- Injection retains exact providers through cleanup. Rc/BoundService alone are not resource leases.
- Service set changes the value without replacing publication identity or reloading consumers.
- Use typed calls/keys/decoders, not JS Proxy/decorators/eval. App-specific Tokio features remain explicit.
- Include uses JSON-valued mutations, bounded synchronous I/O and explicit refresh; YAML writes normalize values.
- GitHub examples grant no permission for login, authenticated requests or live remote mutations.

## English guides

- [Include](en/guides/include.md): Bounded files, nested sources, refresh, provenance and persistence.

- [Loader](en/guides/loader.md): Typed catalogs, bounded JSON, source edits/reconciliation, latest intent and joined shutdown.
- [Groups](en/guides/groups.md): Structural disabled inheritance, stable EntryId, moves and source adoption.
- [Plugins and updates](en/guides/plugins-and-updates.md): Validation, source/resolved config, latest-target convergence, explicit recovery.
- [Services and scoping](en/guides/services-and-scoping.md): Publication, injection, isolation, bound calls, intercepts.
- [Effects and cleanup](en/guides/effects-and-cleanup.md): Acquisition, composition, rollback, shutdown.
- [Timers](en/guides/timers.md): Owner-scoped timeout, sleep, interval/stream, throttle, debounce.
- [Events](en/guides/events.md): Typed dispatch, responder versus around callbacks, snapshots, async timing.
- [Logging](en/guides/logging.md): Scoped exporters, routing, error trees, weak metadata.
- [Console output](en/guides/console-logging.md): Owned writers, stdout, color/UTC defaults, I/O failures and removal.
- [Testing and troubleshooting](en/guides/testing-and-troubleshooting.md): Common errors and deterministic lifecycle checks.
- [Examples](en/guides/examples.md): Complete lifecycle and bounded GitHub consumers; distinguish offline from live operations.
- [Glossary](en/glossary.md): Shared English/Vietnamese terminology.

## API reference

- [Include API](en/api/include.md): File operations, reports, locations and resource limits.

- [English API index](en/api/README.md): Every root export and local Rustdoc generation.
- [Vietnamese API index](vi/api/README.md): Matching reference chapters in Vietnamese.
- [Runtime and Context](en/api/runtime-context.md): Hosting, metadata, scope, opaque IDs.
- [Plugins and Registry](en/api/plugins-registry.md): Plugin, FiberHandle, lifecycle tasks, state, Registry.
- [Services and reflection](en/api/services-reflection.md): Keys, publications, bound adapters, accessors, invocation.
- [Effects](en/api/effects.md): Disposer, Effect, Completion, cleanup reports, local supporting types.
- [Events](en/api/events.md): Listener shapes, dispatch results, one-use continuations.
- [Logging](en/api/logging.md): Logger, records, ErrorValue, exporter options, formatting.
- [Errors and hooks](en/api/errors-hooks.md): Error families, structured validation, typed internal hook protocols.
- [Loader API](en/api/loader.md): Snapshots, operation stages, typed services, source/commit/replacement seams and bounds.
- [Group API](en/api/groups.md): Ordered children, stable entry moves and Fiber rebuild adaptation.
- [Timer satellite](en/api/timer.md): Sealed TimerExt, eager Sleep, bounded IntervalStream, Scheduled call Result, TimerError and cancellation contracts.
- [Console satellite](en/api/console-logger.md): register/register_stdout/render, ConsoleOptions, color and writer contracts.
